symptom: After signing out of account A and into B without a restart, B inherited A's state: device-wide 'Always allow' let B's cloud agents run local commands without asking, A's notifications opened A's chat targets, and A's dashboard filter and ready-copy cache carried over.
rule: Account-scoped consent and caches are keyed per account (no ownerless consent is adopted); sign-out/account switch retires notifications, filters and pruned chats' drafts, including late composer flushes. See playbooks/bug-fix.md.
